AIDescription:
### General Description
Searches for Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) in the VirusTotal Intelligence dataset using the VirusTotal query syntax. This action allows security analysts to perform complex threat hunting queries directly from Google SecOps. It retrieves detailed information about files, URLs, and domains that match the search criteria. Note that this action requires a VirusTotal Enterprise API token.

### Flow Description
1. Extracts the search query, entity creation preference, sorting options, and result limits.
2. Validates the 'Max IOCs To Return' parameter to ensure it is a positive integer.
3. Executes the search against the VirusTotal Intelligence API using the provided query and sorting parameters.
4. If 'Create Entities' is enabled, iterates through the results and adds them to the case as new entities (Domain, URL, or FileHash) if they do not already exist.
5. Returns the search results as a JSON object.

### Additional Notes
- This action does not perform enrichment on existing entities in the case; instead, it searches the global VirusTotal database and can optionally populate the case with new entities.
- When 'Create Entities' is enabled, the action checks if an entity already exists in the case before adding it to prevent duplicates.
AiShortDescription: Searches for Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) in the VirusTotal Intelligence dataset using the VirusTotal query syntax and optionally creates new entities in the case.
ParametersDescription:
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Query | String | Yes | Specify the query according to the VirusTotal query search syntax. |
| Create Entities | Boolean | No | If enabled, action will create entities for the returned IOCs. Note: this action does not enrich entities. |
| Order By | String | Yes | Specify the order by the selected field, in which results are returned. Default: Use Default Order. Note: Entity types might have different ordering fields. Refer to the VT Intelligence corpus https://docs.virustotal.com/reference/intelligence-search for more information. |
| Sort Order | String | No | Specify the direction in which the results should be returned. If “Use Default Order” is chosen for “Order By” field, this parameter will be ignored. |
| Max IOCs To Return | Integer | No | Specify how many IOCs to return. Max IOCs to return is 300. Default: 10. |
